title: Boutiqaat AI Search Visibility Report
methodology: This report measures observable AI-search visibility under controlled queries. It does NOT reverse-engineer proprietary ranking algorithms. Observations (mention rates, rankings) are distinguished from inferences (opportunity explanations).

top_opportunities.title: Competitor-heavy recommendation landscape
top_opportunities.recommendation: Differentiate on GCC-specific assortment, Arabic content, and local brand partnerships.

top_opportunities.title: Potential geographic relevance gap
top_opportunities.explanation: Observed signal: Geo-specific query but Boutiqaat not surfaced.
top_opportunities.recommendation: Increase geo-targeted content and third-party GCC retail listicles mentioning Boutiqaat.
top_opportunities.evidence: Geographic intent detected without Boutiqaat presence.

top_opportunities.title: Boutiqaat absent from AI recommendation set
top_opportunities.explanation: Observed signal: Boutiqaat did not appear in this AI-generated answer for a relevant beauty retail query.
top_opportunities.recommendation: Strengthen topical authority content around this query theme (GCC beauty/skincare retail).
top_opportunities.evidence: Query: 'Where to buy dermatologist recommended skincare online GCC?' — zero mention in response.

top_opportunities.title: No third-party sources supporting Boutiqaat
top_opportunities.explanation: Observed signal: Recommendation lacks editorial/review sources citing Boutiqaat.
top_opportunities.recommendation: Pursue authoritative third-party coverage (editorial, reviews, GCC retail guides).
top_opportunities.evidence: Only first-party or no Boutiqaat sources in response.

top_opportunities.title: Missing source citations for Boutiqaat
top_opportunities.explanation: Observed signal: Boutiqaat referenced without supporting URL citations.
top_opportunities.recommendation: Ensure crawlable, citable pages exist for key product/category queries.
top_opportunities.evidence: No Boutiqaat URLs in source list.

top_opportunities.evidence: Mention-only context detected — not ranked as purchase destination.

limitations: LLM responses are non-deterministic (except mock mode).
Limited query set — not exhaustive of all customer questions.
Single provider in initial release; ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google may differ.
No access to proprietary ranking algorithms.
Correlation does not imply causation for opportunity signals.
next_steps: Expand query set across intents and geographies.
Prioritize high-severity opportunities for content/PR actions.
